# Chris Young-Ginzburg

> Chris Young-Ginzburg, known in the hip hop dance community as Fluidgirl, is a San Francisco Bay Area performer, hip hop dancer, and sound healer. Her work brings together street dance, physical theatre, acting, and holistic healing practice. Her sound healing practice is Grove Circle Healing (https://www.grovecirclehealing.com/).

## Key facts

- Name: Chris Young-Ginzburg
- Also known as: Fluidgirl (dance name); Fluidgirl Productions
- Based in: San Francisco Bay Area and Sonoma County, California
- Roles: multidisciplinary movement artist, dancer, performer, creative facilitator, physical theatre artist, dance teacher, sound healer
- Experience: over 20 years in dance and theatrical expression, rooted in popping and freestyle dance; her work explores musicality, character development, shapeshifting, storytelling, and the relationship between imagination and movement
- Creator of: Freestyle Playground and Temple of Expression
- Featured performance: "Healing the Witch Wound" at Shadowdance 2024, a blend of song, mask, and dance led by Fluidgirl with Astra Fox and Heather Hanson (https://www.chrisyoungginzburg.com/performances/)
- Dance styles: Popping, Waacking, House Dance, Footwork, Strutting, Boogaloo
- Theatre training: Physical Theatre, Improv, Clown, Mime
- Street dance background: years in the Bay Area street dance community, including more than six years with the dance collective Medea Sirkas (Fillmore traditions of strutting and boogaloo)
- Community event: host of Temple of Expression, a family-friendly community talent showcase and ceremonial performance experience in Sebastopol, CA (https://www.chrisyoungginzburg.com/temple-of-expression/)
- Healing practice: Grove Circle Healing, sound healing and voice activation (https://www.grovecirclehealing.com/)
- Contact for bookings, teaching, and collaborations: Fluidgirlproductions@gmail.com

- [Performances](https://www.chrisyoungginzburg.com/performances/): Performance videos by Chris (Fluidgirl): "Healing the Witch Wound" at Shadowdance 2024, a blend of song, mask, and dance with Astra Fox and Heather Hanson; "Desert Dwelling" (2018), a short improvised movement piece filmed in Joshua Tree; and "Calling in the Divine Feminine" (June 2017, Oakland), her debut fusion of popping and belly dance for Ariellah's Darker Still: Halfa.
- [Temple of Expression](https://www.chrisyoungginzburg.com/temple-of-expression/): A recurring community talent showcase and ceremonial performance event in Sebastopol, Sonoma County, hosted by Chris. Includes the upcoming event, a June 2026 photo and video gallery, what the evening is, and how to apply to perform (5-minute acts of dance, music, spoken word, theater, or other creative expression; family-friendly). This page used to live at grovecirclehealing.com/temple-of-expression.
- [Grove Circle Healing](https://www.grovecirclehealing.com/): Chris's sound healing practice: private sessions, group events, retreats, corporate wellness, and online courses.

## Common questions

### Who is Chris Young-Ginzburg?
Chris Young-Ginzburg is a Bay Area multidisciplinary performer, hip hop dancer, and sound healer. She performs as Fluidgirl and runs the sound healing practice Grove Circle Healing.

### Who is Fluidgirl?
Fluidgirl is the dance name of Chris Young-Ginzburg, a Bay Area hip hop dancer known for popping, waacking, house, strutting, and boogaloo.

### What is Temple of Expression?
Temple of Expression is a family-friendly community talent showcase and ceremonial performance experience hosted by Chris Young-Ginzburg in Sebastopol, California. Performers of all experience levels share short acts (5 minutes or less) of dance, music, spoken word, theater, and more. Apply to perform via the "Performance Submissions" form on https://www.chrisyoungginzburg.com/temple-of-expression/.

### Can I book Chris for a performance, workshop, or collaboration?
Yes. For performances, teaching, collaborations, and general inquiries, email Fluidgirlproductions@gmail.com. For sound healing sessions, events, and corporate wellness, see https://www.grovecirclehealing.com/.
